تستوجبوا (form X)
# تَسْتَوْجِبُوا (tastawjibū) /tas.taw.d͡ʒi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# تُسْتَوْجَبُوا (tustawjabū) /tus.taw.d͡ʒa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
